_what: Settings for scripts/make-ways-in.mjs: which Trillion records it reads, where it writes, which docs page tells more about a row (by the row's id in those records), the app screen a row with no docs page links to, and the page's words. A row with no entry under pages links to connect_screen.

words.title: Every way to reach Trillion
words.description: The Trillion apps for your phone, browser and computer, and every AI app you can connect, with where to get each one.
words.intro: Trillion is one account you reach from wherever you are: the apps below for your devices, the web at app.gettrillion.ai, and any AI app you already use. Everything you send from one place is there in all the others.
words.ai_heading: From the AI you already use
words.ai_intro: Connect your AI once and it can use Trillion in every chat. Each card says how.
